name: Example executive scorecard (placeholder until the client's real one arrives)

criteria.label: Sector experience
criteria.description: Depth of experience in the company's sector or a close neighbour.

criteria.label: Stage fit
criteria.description: Has worked at a company of similar size, stage and funding (for example growth stage, PE or VC backed).

criteria.label: Scope of past roles
criteria.description: Size of the teams, budgets, territories or revenue they have been responsible for, compared with this role.

criteria.label: Team leadership
criteria.description: Evidence of hiring, developing and leading a team at the level this role needs.

criteria.label: Results delivered
criteria.description: Specific, verifiable outcomes in past roles, such as growth, targets met or teams built.

criteria.label: Functional depth
criteria.description: Command of the function this role leads.

criteria.label: Communication
criteria.description: How clearly they communicate, as shown in notes from conversations and in their materials.

criteria.label: Reason for moving
criteria.description: Whether the record shows a credible, job-related reason to consider this move now.

criteria.label: Location and availability
criteria.description: Fit with the role's location, travel and timing needs, as stated in the job.

recommendation.meaning: yes: worth advancing to a recruiter conversation for this search. no: not for this search.
